Front Plane: The flat sheet you look straight at. Draw a flat part like the wrench here.
Top Plane: The flat sheet lying like the floor.
Right Plane: The flat sheet standing like a side wall.
origin: The 0,0 point of the part: two small arrows in the middle. Start your first shape on it.
Smart Dimension: The tool that sets an exact size. Click a line or circle, place the number, type the size.
Circle: Sketch tool: click the center, move out, click again.
Line: Sketch tool: click to start, click at each corner. Esc to stop.
Tangent: A relation that makes a line and a curve join smoothly, with no corner.
Horizontal: A relation that makes two points line up level, left to right.
Trim Entities: Sketch tool that erases pieces of lines and circles.
Power trim: Trim mode: hold the left button and drag across the pieces to erase them.
Extruded Boss/Base: Features tool that pushes a closed sketch into a 3D solid.
Extruded Cut: Features tool that removes material through a closed sketch.
Mid Plane: Extrude setting that grows the part equally both ways from the sketch.
Through All: Cut setting that cuts all the way through the part.
Polygon: Sketch tool for shapes with equal sides, like a hexagon.
Inscribed circle: Polygon setting: the dashed circle touches the middle of each flat side, so it sets the size across the flats.
Fillet: Features tool that rounds an edge to a radius you type.
Chamfer: Features tool that cuts an edge to a flat bevel.
Edit Sketch: Opens a sketch again so you can change it. The pencil icon.
Exit Sketch: Leaves the sketch and keeps it. Top-right corner of the part area.
Measure: Evaluate tool that reads real distances and sizes on your part.
IPS: Inch, pound, second: the unit system this class uses.
MMGS: Millimeter, gram, second: metric units. Not what this class uses.
Features tab: The tab with the 3D tools: Extruded Boss/Base, Cut, Fillet.
Sketch tab: The tab with the 2D drawing tools: Line, Circle, Smart Dimension, Trim.
Evaluate tab: The tab with checking tools like Measure and Mass Properties.
green check: OK. Finishes the tool and keeps what you did.
red X: Cancel. Throws away what the tool was about to do.
rollback bar: The yellow and black bar in the tree. Everything below it is switched off.
SketchXpert: A helper that finds conflicting dimensions and relations in a red sketch.
Over Defined: Two rules in the sketch are fighting. The lines turn red or yellow.
Under Defined: Some lines can still move. Normal while you work.
Fully Defined: Every line is locked by dimensions and relations. Lines are black.
Save As: Saves a copy with the name you type.
.SLDPRT: A SolidWorks part file. This is what you hand in.
Check Sketch for Feature: Tools, Sketch Tools: finds gaps and crossing lines in a sketch.
Document Recovery: The panel on the right that holds an autosaved copy after a crash.
Boss-Extrude1: The first extrude you made. Its sketch is inside it: click the arrow.
For construction: Turns a line into a dashed guide that never becomes solid.
Centerline: A dashed guide line, used for mirroring.
Esc: Stop the tool you are using.
Ctrl+8: Turn the view to look straight at the sketch or face.
tree: The list on the left: every step of your part, in order.
dimension: A number that sets a size in a sketch.
sketch: A flat 2D drawing on a plane or a face.
